title: Critique: absorbed experience would count as unconscious

statements.text: In absorption, such as watching a gripping movie, tasks are so engaging that they seem to exclude higher-order metacognitive thinking, and frontal regions for introspection and self-related processing deactivate. The higher-order view would then wrongly count the most engaging sensory moments as unconscious.

sources.quote: Under Lau and Rosenthal’s proposal, these most engaging sensory moments will most likely be deemed ‘unconscious’ given their apparent lack of high order thought content.
frontal brain regions specialized for introspection and self-related processing actually reduce their activity under highly demanding sensory tasks
